primaryLaw.name: Orden HAP/1370/2014, de 25 de julio, por la que se aprueba la reglamentación básica del juego de máquinas de azar

article8InformationDuties.quotedRequirement: Porcentaje del importe de la participación del jugador que se destina a la formación del bote.

article14JackpotFunding.interpretation: For the Spanish online slot-machine regime, an operator-funded guaranteed seed cannot simply be assumed from a help file prepared for another market. A post-award displayed reserve may still be compatible if it derives from prior player participation; its funding provenance must be established rather than inferred.

diamondBonanza.regulatoryRetrievalTarget: Exact percentage of each participation allocated to the jackpot in the currently served Spanish rules/interface.

jackpotKing.safeInterpretation: Spain-facing contribution and reserve disclosures can be used only per exact title/configuration. A generic Blueprint statement that an initial seed is operator-funded cannot be imported into Spain without reconciling it with the Spanish prohibition on guaranteed jackpots funded from operator/non-participation sources. A player-funded reserve is a distinct possibility.

requiredCaptureChecklist: Exact current in-game rules/help file served to the Spanish account/session.
Exact percentage of participation allocated to the jackpot, as required by Article 8(k).
Exact decomposition, if shown, between live pot funding and reserve funding.
Reset/reserve amount and evidence of its funding provenance.
Exact trigger/award rules and title/version fingerprint.
For shared pools, evidence identifying which games/markets contribute to the displayed Spanish pot.
